notes.title: Multiplayer for Arms Race 2 is now live!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello comrades![/b][/p][p]
I'm thrilled to announce that our small team has finally released the multiplayer mode for [i]Arms Race 2[/i] — and the best part? It's completely free![/p][p][/p][p]Just download the demo, and you'll be able to enjoy both single-player and multiplayer modes. Want to play with a friend? notes.title: Multiplayer for Arms Race 2
notes.notes:
Exciting News, Comrades!

I'm thrilled to announce that our small but mighty team has just wrapped up closed beta testing for the multiplayer mode in Arms Race 2! It’s been a wild ride full of challenges, but we’ve overcome them—and multiplayer is now running smoothly and ready for action.

In the early days of testing, launching a server and connecting players could take up to 3 minutes. But now? It’s lightning fast—just 3 to 5 seconds!

To make finding allies easier, I’ve created a matchmaking thread on the Arms Race 2 Steam forum. If you're looking for teammates to strategize and dominate with, drop your contact info there and coordinate your sessions—super simple and super fast!

I also want to extend a heartfelt thank you to all of you for your amazing support. Your feedback has been 100% positive so far, and for a small indie team like ours, that means the world. It was your incredible support that truly inspired us to bring multiplayer to life. We built it for you—and we can’t wait to see you all playing together

And here’s a bonus: your friends don’t need to own AR2 to play with you! The free demo of Arms Race 2 is fully integrated with multiplayer. Just have them download it and jump right into battle with you.

Multiplayer launches later this month—before June begins.

Get ready for an unforgettable summer of strategy, alliances, and global domination in Arms Race 2!

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2284800/discussions/0/597399505222036447/

Max Sprin

notes.title: Summer v037 update
notes.notes:
Hi comrades,

To all demo and beta owners:

We are pleased to announce the release of the v037 update. One particular feature in this update requires special attention from those who experienced the issue of clutter on their screens. Some players reported issues with in-game windows overlapping in the previous version, and we diligently investigated to find the root cause. After thorough analysis, we discovered that the problem arose due to varying monitor resolutions, particularly all except 16:9 and 16:10. We are happy to inform you that this issue has been resolved (hopefully). Regardless of your monitor's resolution, windows should no longer stack on top of each other (unless you have a triangular or portrait-sized monitor).

Apart from that, we have made some tweaks to the in-game balance and mechanics:

AI will now protect its own country without spreading resources if it is engaged in an ongoing war within its borders.
AI will attempt a peaceful revolution (coup d'état) if it possesses all the necessary units in its pool, instead of resorting to a civil war to speed up the process.
The UN resolution for peacekeeping now costs 50 UN points (reduced from 80).
AI will use the UN resolution for peacekeeping as soon as it becomes available during an ongoing war within its own country.
We have edited some of the news text to make it shorter and fit better on the TV screen.

We hope you will enjoy this update. Have a great summer!
Max Sprin

notes.title: New 036 beta update
notes.notes:
Hello comrades!

I am delighted to inform you about the 036 update we have just rolled out on Steam. First and foremost, we have successfully resolved the issue with loading time. Now, the game loads within seconds! There's no need to wait anymore to play AR2. We tackled this problem by providing players with a choice in how they receive in-game news. By default, news is displayed with pictures on the TV screen. However, for those with more powerful computers who prefer videos over pictures, you can change this setting in the options menu by selecting the "video news" option. Please note that in this case, you will experience a slightly longer loading time, as it was before. So now, the choice is yours: super-fast game loading with news in pictures or a longer wait time upon loading for 3D video news.

Secondly, we have added a windowed screen option. I have received some complaints from demo testers about the "mess on the screen." Unfortunately, this is a limitation specific to the Unity engine, and we are unable to precisely match the game screen to a player's non-standard monitor settings. The most common issue arises with widescreen monitors, such as 3440x1440. Now, players can adjust the screen in windowed mode to their desired size and view. However, please note that some tutorial graphics may not fit perfectly in windowed mode. We are unable to address this at the moment.

Additionally, we have implemented several small fixes and additions. For example, we have included more hints on pop-up screens to enhance navigation through the user interface.

Thank you, and we hope you thoroughly enjoy the game!

Max Sprin

notes.title: Beta 0.34
notes.notes:
Important message to all beta owners!

We have received message from an YouTuber who reported to as about YouTube questioning about copyright claims on some musical content in their videos after uploading video with our game. After an investigation I found out that some musicians have changed their musical upload platforms after we obtained their music content. This caused confusion. Platforms have different polices related to copyrights. But copyrights were not violated. The current platform use free copy license which allows YouTubers to upload videos with our game musical content. The general meaning of YouTube message is related to monetization and not restrict us from using the audio content.

Even if everything is legal and we can use music content in our game and on YouTube I decided to remove it from the game. I would like to avoid confusion with music content in our game in any forms for us and for YouTubers. 

Some musical tracks have been removed and other replaced with another music tracks which I hope you will enjoy while playing the game. All this is applied to the current version of the beta 0.34. Please, use new version of the beta for your videos.

Thank you and I'm sorry for inconvenience
Max Sprin

notes.title: April news update for Arms Race 2 - industry and demo
notes.notes:
Hello comrades!

Monthly news are here! I honestly can't wait to tell you - we are going to present our demo on Steam fest in June! Yeah, you guys will be able to play free demo and very soon! Currently we are polishing it to make sure you will enjoy it at the best!

We are open to provide copies for press and video bloggers. Send me a message if you want to try the beta before anybody else!

And now, like usually, let's take a look on new game features. On the screenshot below you can see how new industrial contracts work. Industrial contracts provide extra units and increase game scores once it is completed between two regions. One region must be part of your alliance and the other can be your alliance or neutral. Here you can see the list of current contracts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43538918/867ba36c48d00b26a0324f1390fd1f9bc064f864.png[/img]

Additionally to the list in Industry menu you can see contracts on the globe. It is small 3d model of factories. Orange models are for Soviet contracts and greenish for Democratic. Contract units under production do not take money from budget. More contracts you have more units you produce. Build smart I'd say! And yeah, more contracts = more game scores for your alliance. It's a win win situation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43538918/c82df9ab6976ae31c92d3771a6dfedbcec6b0b23.png[/img]

Oh, and look at the bottom left corner of the screenshot above. I wonder what is this button device for and how to activate it? You have a guess what it can be for? ;)

Thank you and please, share link to this game or announcement with your friends. They also want to know about Arms Race 2!

As additional information you may want to know we are working on another Cold War project which we hope will be released in early access this year. Check it out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1264830/The_Cold_War_Era_2

If you are bored to wait and want to play Cold War now, please, support us with this bundle.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10404/The_Cold_War_Era_Bundle/

Thank you
Max Sprin
